sn20.2:1.2: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn20.2:1.4: katamannukho bahutaraṃ yo vāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavīti?
sn20.2:1.6: appamattakoyaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.
sn20.2:1.7: saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropitoti.
sn20.2:1.8: eva meva kho bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti.
sn20.2:1.9: atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
